items.title: File Widerspruch against Krankengeld denial
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) 27.01.2026 (Tuesday), no separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' date is stated, so the letter's own date counts as the posting day. Muster BKK is a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), so § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies: the letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, and unlike tax offices this deemed-delivery day is NOT moved even if it falls on a weekend. Counting: 28.01 (day 1), 29.01 (day 2), 30.01 (day 3), 31.01.2026 (day 4, a Saturday) = deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG, counted per §§ 187, 188 BGB) starts the day after delivery and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day before the start, i.e. one month after 31.01.2026. February 2026 has only 28 days (2026 is not a leap year), so per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends on the last day of February, 28.02.2026. That day is a Saturday (01.01.2026 is a Thursday, so 28.02.2026 falls on a Saturday), so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 64 Abs. 3 SGG the deadline moves to the next working day. Sunday 01.03.2026 is skipped; Monday 02.03.2026 is not a public holiday in NRW, so the deadline is Monday, 02.03.2026.
